marina (PM): Quick note: I'm proposing we compress the Optimize toolkit scope to a tight alpha: pragmatic batch/caching heuristics, two quant profiles, and a lightweight eval-alert proof-of-concept. Keep it customer-ready but minimal.

dev (Eng): Sounds reasonable. Suggest split: alpha-v1 = static heuristics + quant docs + SDK example; alpha-v2 = alerting plumbing + canary dashboards. That keeps rollout low-risk.

nora (ML): For quant we should ship: 8-bit Q4 and 4-bit adaptive. I'll produce a small evaluation pack (1.5k prompts each) focusing on hallucination-sensitive tasks and classification.

sage (Solutions): Field ask: one large fintech wanted per-route opt-out for quant and explicit guidance for regulatory flows. They will sign up for alpha-v1 if we provide a checklist.

marina (PM): Proposed acceptance for alpha-v1: (a) per-model quant recommendation + measured delta on defined eval set (<3% drop), (b) suggested batch_size + cache_ttl defaults with rationale for 80/95/99 latency targets, (c) 1-page quickstart + sample SDK call. Agree?

dev (Eng): Agree but add non-functional: feature-flagged rollout, no p99 regression > 5ms on Dedicated pools, and telemetry hooks for customers.
nora (ML): Metric proposal: use BLEURT/MAUVE for semantic + task-specific F1 for classification. Alert trigger idea: rolling 2k requests with >4% quality delta or token-error-rate > +3 sigma.

sage (Solutions): Also include an easy toggle in the SDK: "quant: conservative|balanced|aggressive" and a per-route header to disable. We'll include example for disabling.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: optimize-alpha-v1-canary-1717559999, region=us-east-1, window=48h. Logs -> /canaries/optimize-toolkit.

marina (PM): Timing: nora to deliver eval pack + thresholds by Thu EOD; dev to stub flags + SDK example by next Tue; sage to draft quickstart + customer checklist by Mon. Follow-up sync Fri 9am PT.

dev (Eng): I'll also surface a simple cost-benefit table for sales: approximate token-cost reduction estimates with examples (short chat vs long-context) so they can set expectations.
nora (ML): Note: long-context (>8k) clients often see reduced quant gains. I'll include a small appendix with sample numbers.
sage (Solutions): I'll contact the fintech pilot and confirm if they want early access with the conservative defaults.

marina (PM): Perfect. I'll turn this into a short RFC and link the checklist + canary job. Thanks all :rocket:
